messages.content: "你能計算多項式函數 '3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7' 的導數，並在x=4時評估這個導數嗎？接下來，你可以把產生的結果函數再計算一次導數並在x=2時評估嗎？"

function.name: calculate_derivative
function.description: Calculate the derivative of a polynomial function. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

x_value.description: The x-value at which the derivative is calculated. Optional, if not given, the function will return a function of the derivative instead of a specific value. default is 0.

That gives us derivative value at 4. But we also need the derivative function itself to differentiate again. So we need to call without x_value to get derivative function. Then call again on that function with x_value=2.

Thus two calls: first call calculate_derivative with function="3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7", no x_value -> returns derivative function as string. Second call calculate_derivative with function=derivative_function_string, x_value=2 -> returns numeric value.
